comment: Nitpick: Fujiwara's conducting is wrong, it is 2 beats out of sync. In 4/4 time signature, the big diagonal swing should always land on the first beat of a bar, but Fujiwara signals the first beat with the small outward swing instead, which is the 3rd beat in 4/4. This doesn't really matter to the untrained eye, but to anyone that's participated in music teams this is incredibly off-putting, which is a shame considering the level of detail and care put into the rest of the anime.
